newsitem.title: CROATIA: EBRD grants 10 mln marks loan to Croatia bank - TV.
newsitem.headline: EBRD grants 10 mln marks loan to Croatia bank - TV.

text.p: The European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD) granted a 10 million German marks loan to Croatia's Alpe-Jadran Banka on Thursday, the state television (HRT) reported.
The loan was intended for small and medium-sized enterprises, mostly manufacturers.
HRT said enterpreneurs can count on up to 500,000 marks per loan which will be granted for five years at an annual rate of 13 percent.
Loans are primarily intended for entrepreneurs from the maritime area of Dalmatia, where Alpe-Jadran Banka is based, HRT said.
Alpe Jadran was also negotiating similar deals with the World Bank, the television said. -- Laura Lui, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
